title: Lorie Clark
description: Used her department’s Instagram page to promote an LGBT candidate running for town council.
body:
# Lorie Clark

# Coordinator of Student Leadership and Engagement

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/clark.jpg)

- After Trump won in 2024, **[she posted](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/8c33631b-e6ef-4d63-a1f5-9afbad90b59b/CHCCS-Lorie-Clark-stay-vigilant.png)** “Buckle up, stay vigilant and keep your passport current!”
- **[Advocates](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/53ef8986-cef7-4751-a02b-be6996ef518f/CHCCS-Lorie-Clark-BLM-advocate.png)** for the Marxist BLM organization. Her is filled with “no justice, no peace” and BLM protest photos.

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/clark1.png)

- Her department held **[race-specific](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/6e43b5e9-83d4-4994-b65c-46d50ccbc81c/CHCCS-Lorie-Clark-black-and-latinx-college.png)** college and career events.
- Used her department’s Instagram page **[to promote](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/020aee3b-91b7-46cf-b135-54f2ef17ef39/CHCCS-Lorie-Clark-equity-dept-promoting-LGBT-candidate-for-council.png)** an LGBT candidate running for town council
